messages:
elaine: dropping a compact mock for the Billing page. big fork: summary-first cards (one row per project with chip + sparkline) vs full ledger rows by default. figma: https://figma.com/s/billing-compact-vs-ledger

ben: summary cards are way easier to scan at org level. ledger is still useful for deep debugging but should be a secondary view.

anya: accessibility check: if cards collapse to show details, ensure `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. avoid hover-only interactions for cost details.

maya: copy nudge: header says "Token breakdown"  can we try "Usage summary" across top-level views? less jargon for new users.

sam: where to put invoice download? summary row CTA opens modal with "Download statement (PDF)"; ledger rows have per-line "View invoice" links. this satisfies audit while keeping compact rows clean.

ben: metric add: show median + p95 tokens on the summary row so ops can spot noisy projects without expanding. small sparkline to the right.

anya: sparklines OK but if conveying data include offscreen text: "Trend: up 8%". if decorative, set aria-hidden.

maya: UX pattern proposal: default behavior = org scope shows summary cards, project scope shows ledger. global toggle near scope pill: "View: Summary | Ledger". store preference per-account.

sam: storing pref per-account OK. also make toggle keyboard-accessible as a single tab stop and announce via screen reader.

elaine: mobile: always start in summary and drill into project. ledger is too dense on phones.

ben: backend note: summary view needs pre-aggregation. add API param `aggregate=project,period` returning total, median, p95, sparkline samples.

maya: design decision: show cost fiat inline in chip `4.2k tokens  $0.23` or tokens-only with cost on expand? i'm leaning chip with both for discoverability.

anya: chips must be focusable and expose text for screen readers: "4,200 tokens, cost $0.23". do not hide cost behind hover.

sam: legal wants explicit invoice id mapping. keep invoice id in expanded ledger and in the invoice modal metadata.

ui-bot: Mock uploaded by maya at 2026-10-11T09:02:10Z  /figma/billing-summary-v3

maya: next steps: I'll push two annotated mocks (summary-first + ledger-first), include ARIA notes and copy variants for "Usage summary" vs "Token breakdown". posting by EOD.

ben: once mock's up i'll sync with infra for the `aggregate` contract and pagination on expand.

anya: I'll run a quick a11y pass on the prototype and validate keyboard expand/collapse flow.

elaine: timeline: prototype by Mon? legal needs to review the "Statement" label before release.

maya: aiming for Monday morning. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
